Madison, Wisconsin 53702
Dear Mr. Herried:
The following information is being provided to you for possible use in the preparation of the final environmental impact statement on the proposed Airport Spur Freeway in Milwaukee County, Wisconsin.
This agency's review of the draft environmental impact statement raised questions about the continued status of General Mitchell Field as the commercial air carrier airport. Through periodic contact with your staff, we have indicated the status of the regional airport system plan currently under preparation which addresses, among other issues, the best means of providing commercial air carrier service to southeastern Wisconsin. The system planning process had advanced to a stage in July 1974 where the Commission could indicate, in its statement for the public hearing on the environmental impact of the proposed Airport Spur, that five alternative regional airport system plans where being considered, four of which plans retained General Mitchell Field as the regional air carrier airport and a fifth alternative system plan which would relocate the air carrier airport to another location within the Region.
Since that public hearing, the regional airport system planning program has progressed to the point where technical staff and Committee review have eliminated from further technical consideration any alternative regional airport system plan which would provide a regional air carrier airport at any location other than the existing site of General Mitchell Field. The regional airport system plan being readied for public information and hearing, therefore, will include a specific recommendation that General Mitchell Field remain as the single air carrier airport within the Region. Although this recommendation is subject to public hearing, Commission action, and implementing agency review and adoption, the technical studies clearly indicate that General Mitchell Field will be adequate to serve the commercial aviation needs of the Region for at least the next 30 years.
